photo_requests.title: Cold storage area
photo_requests.instruction: Upload a clear photo showing the refrigerator, freezer or cold storage area used for the finished product.
photo_requests.reason: This helps assess cold-storage conditions and temperature-control evidence.

photo_requests.title: Heating or cooking equipment
photo_requests.instruction: Upload a photo showing the main equipment used to cook or heat the product.
photo_requests.reason: This helps identify the equipment used for the controlled heating stage.

photo_requests.title: Packaging area
photo_requests.instruction: Upload a photo showing where the product is filled, packed or sealed.
photo_requests.reason: This helps assess product handling during packaging.

photo_requests.title: Main production workspace
photo_requests.instruction: Upload a wide photo showing the main area where the food is prepared.
photo_requests.reason: This provides general evidence about the production environment.

photo_requests.title: Cleaning and handwashing setup
photo_requests.instruction: Upload a photo showing the handwashing area, cleaning materials or cleaning equipment.
photo_requests.reason: This helps assess whether suitable cleaning facilities are available.

photo_requests.title: Finished packaged product
photo_requests.instruction: Upload a clear photo of the finished product and its current packaging or label.
photo_requests.reason: This helps assess packaging and visible product-label information.

document_requests.title: Temperature record
document_requests.instruction: Upload a recent refrigerator or freezer temperature record, if one is available.
document_requests.reason: This provides evidence of storage-temperature monitoring.

document_requests.title: Product label
document_requests.instruction: Upload the current product label or a file containing the label design.
document_requests.reason: This helps assess the product information currently provided to customers.

document_requests.title: Ingredient list or recipe sheet
document_requests.instruction: Upload an ingredient list or recipe sheet without confidential quantities, if available.
document_requests.reason: This helps identify raw materials and possible allergen considerations.

document_requests.title: Cleaning record
document_requests.instruction: Upload a cleaning schedule or completed cleaning record, if one is available.
document_requests.reason: This provides evidence that cleaning activities are planned or recorded.
